## Abstract

This project provides visualizations to determine how IMDB ratings and character speaking lines have changed across seasons or eras of the Simpsons. This will be done by showing a boxplot of the different IMDB ratings for each showrunner era, showing the median rating and ranges of outcomes. The analysis will also include a heatmap showing the top 10 characters who speak the most lines per era.
